warnings: Eleven standard installation details -- fixture connections, floor drains, cleanouts and vent terminals.
*** A 0.30 M AIR CHAMBER IS REQUIRED AT EVERY WATER FIXTURE (basin, WC, urinal, shower). *** It is a real length of pipe per fixture and appears on no plan or schedule -- only here.

*** THE HOT/COLD CONVENTION IS STATED ONCE IN THE WHOLE SET, on the basin detail: cold on the RIGHT, hot on the LEFT, '(ถ้ามี)'. *** No hot-water system is drawn anywhere in this house, which is why it is conditional.

THREE OF THESE DETAILS ARE FOR FIXTURES THIS HOUSE DOES NOT HAVE: the flush-valve WC (WC1), the urinal (UR), and arguably the RD/RFD roof drains for a flat roof. They are standard office details carried onto the sheet, and their presence is NOT evidence the fixture exists. A-29's สุขภัณฑ์ list is the authority on what is actually installed -- it schedules a cistern WC and no urinal.
The house uses the FLUSH TANK detail (cistern WC), matching A-29 and SN-07's ø3/4" CW branch.
BOTH AVC TYPES ARE DETAILED HERE, top and side-outlet, resolving what SN-01's legend could only distinguish by drawn symbol. SN-06 says the house uses the SIDE-OUTLET type.
The FCO cover is specified as EITHER standard threaded brass OR cast iron / galvanised steel -- a genuine either/or that a take-off has to price one way.
